observations: Silver Samsung front-load washing machine in a tiled room, likely bathroom/utility area.
Front panel reads 'SAMSUNG' and below the drum window 'ecobubble 6.0kg'.
Digital display shows a code/digits (not clearly legible, could be clock or error code).
Drain/outlet hose is visible, routed up and out of frame.
Door is closed; drum interior looks clean through the glass but lighting limits detail.
No rating plate, serial number, or full model number visible anywhere in the shot.
Only one angle (front) is shown; back, sides, cord, and plug are not visible.

claims.claim: Samsung faulty ecobubble 6kg washing machine for sale
claims.evidence: Photo 0 confirms brand and capacity label, but 'faulty' nature/cause cannot be seen or tested remotely; seller's own admission is taken as worst case.
No geotag or address proof in photo.

risks.risk: Nature and severity of the fault (e.g., motor, PCB/control board, drum bearing, drain pump, heating element) unknown — drastically changes repair cost and value.
risks.proof: Video of seller attempting to power on the unit and showing any error code or behavior (or a technician's written diagnosis).

risks.risk: Drum bearing or spider arm condition (common failure on old Samsung ecobubble units) could mean drum wobble or rust leaking onto clothes.
risks.proof: Close-up video of hand-spinning the drum, listening for grinding noise, and photo of underside of drum for rust streaks.
risks.if_unproven: priced as if bearings are worn

risks.risk: Missing or illegible rating plate/model number means exact model, voltage, and year of manufacture (affecting parts availability) are unknown.
risks.proof: Clear photo of the rating plate/serial sticker, usually on the rear or inside the door rim.
risks.if_unproven: priced using only the visible 6kg ecobubble capacity tier, no model premium

risks.risk: Condition of power cord, plug, and inlet/outlet hoses not shown; could be damaged or missing parts.
risks.proof: Photos of rear of machine showing cord, plug, and both hoses.
risks.if_unproven: priced assuming hoses/cord may need replacement

risks.risk: Unknown water damage, rust on base, or mold inside drum/seal not visible from this single front angle.
risks.proof: Photos of the rubber door gasket close-up, detergent drawer, and base/feet of machine.
risks.if_unproven: priced assuming cosmetic/hidden wear is present

proof_requests: Video of seller plugging in and attempting to run the machine, showing any display code or complete non-response.
Clear photo of the rating/serial plate (usually rear panel or inside door frame) for exact model number.
Close-up video of hand-spinning the drum to check bearing noise and wobble.
Photos of the rear of the unit: power cord, plug, inlet/outlet hoses.
Close-up of rubber door gasket and detergent drawer for mold/rust.
response.reason: Brand and capacity are visible and the seller admits the unit is faulty, so it can be priced at worst case as a non-working 6kg Samsung ecobubble front-loader; the exact fault, model number, and hidden wear remain unverified and would only raise the price if proven otherwise.
